_read: The configuration of the PROJECT that uses the method. It is the only file whoever adopts
Holdrim has to edit: the name and where the content is.
The engine (engine/, served by the image) knows none of this — it asks here.
Environment variables beat this file, so one repository can serve more than one environment —
except `language`, where HOLDRIM_LANGUAGE counts only when the file names none.
This one points at the example. For your documentation, copy examples/template/ and edit (examples/hello-world/ is the smallest start that works).
name: Holdrim
_name: Shown in page titles and in the menu.
_owner: WHO APPROVES IS NOT HERE, and may not be: a file that names `owner`, `admins` or `locks` refuses
to load. Authority is set by the deployment, in HOLDRIM_OWNER (ONE e-mail: their ✓ becomes a
lock) and HOLDRIM_ADMINS (comma separated), because whoever can commit to this file is not
whoever deploys it. engine/run-local.sh names a placeholder owner when the variable is unset.
_theme: HOW YOUR PROJECT DRESSES THE ENGINE — optional, in the Keycloak arrangement. Without it the
engine wears its own neutral look, which is nobody's brand. Example:
brand: hex only, three or six digits. Anything else is refused and written to the log — the
value ends up inside a stylesheet.
logo:  a path inside the project (svg, png, webp, jpg, gif, up to 64 KiB). The server reads
the file and inlines it; with no logo, the name is shown.
name:  what the sign-in screen calls the product. By default, the `name` above.
This repository sets no theme on purpose: the engine has to keep looking like the engine.
_content: WHERE YOUR DOCUMENTATION LIVES. The engine knows nothing of this.
folders: where the reviewable pages are. registry: the approvals file, which is the lock.
home: where the root of the site leads. trimPrefix: the part of the path not worth showing.
pageExamples: only appears in the invalid-page error message.
_development: Who you pretend to be, and the port, when running locally: engine/run-local.sh, or NODE_ENV=development / HOLDRIM_ENVIRONMENT=Development.
